profile.headline: Software Engineer @ WB Games San Diego | Mathematics, Computer Science
profile.summary: I'm Eric Sauer, a software engineer, mobile developer, and lifelong gamer with a background in Math and Computer Science. I specialize in building gameplay features, mobile applications, and interactive digital experiences that are reliable, intuitive, and thoughtfully designed. My work combines strong technical foundations with a creative approach to problem-solving, whether I'm developing user-facing features, improving mobile experiences, or exploring new tools and technologies. I'm especially interested in the ways software, games, and emerging AI tools can come together to create useful, engaging, and well-crafted products.

Hackillinois IT
positions.description: Hackillinois is a 36 hour event where college students from across the country create technical projects ranging from websites and mobile apps to Wi-Fi connected microwaves. As IT support, I maintain the system of communication and resources. I also set up and run the online stream.

positions.title: Game Developer for MechMania 2015
positions.description: I managed and developed the game for MechMania, which is an annual programming contest. Teams compete by writing an AI for a game (the type of which varies from year to year). After a day of coding and debugging, teams compete in an elimination tournament shown on a wall-sized projection screen.

positions.description: Software Security and Server Developer. Collaborated on front and back end development. PackSay combines fast, scalable vote-handling with a simple, location-based, no-login web application.

positions.title: Summer Intern for Center  of Cyber Defenders
positions.description: Developed the Forensic Analysis Repository for Malware System (FARM) which provides computer security experts  the ability to automate detection of malware and build a central database for research. Designed new innovative cyber security tools to detect malware in non executable files, such as image files, archive files, Microsoft documents, and portable document format (PDF) files.

positions.description: Designed the front and back end for Sandia's Mega Tux Project, a supercomputer used to emulate the Internet and study the behavior of botnets.
